hero.title: Get in Touch
hero.subtitle: Have questions? We're here to help. Reach out to us through any of the methods below.

form.title: Send us a Message

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Tell us more about your inquiry...

form.successDescription: We'll get back to you soon.

hours.question: What are your support hours?
hours.answer: Our support team is available 24/7 via live chat and email. Phone support is available Monday-Friday, 8am-6pm EST.

response.question: How quickly will I get a response?
response.answer: We typically respond to all inquiries within 2-4 hours during business hours, and within 24 hours for messages received outside business hours.

emergency.question: Do you offer emergency support?
emergency.answer: Yes! For urgent technical issues or emergencies, please call our hotline at +1 (555) 123-4567 and press 1 for immediate assistance.

demo.question: Can I schedule a demo?
demo.answer: Absolutely! Click the 'Schedule Demo' button on our homepage or mention it in your message, and we'll set up a personalized demonstration.
